author: @mel
text:
There was no trading for me today. I only could get in front of my
computer around 10 am my time, I was unprepared and decided to just
watch the screen untill during London .

I enjoyed doing it as I took the time to sit and see how beautifully price really behaves.

While doing this, you see the battle that is going on, you see who came
out as a winner, the bulls or the bears and you also see why they won
the battle. You see when the next army sits and where they are waiting
for another battle.

Once again this exercise confirmed to me that Decision Points are extremely powerfull...

Along the day I had a few thoughts about the beginning of my trading
"career" and how I looked at things back then. There is a saying that I
really love, it is "Knowledge is Power" How true it is!

When you have the knowledge you can flip the table around and finally take control!

Sure it took some time and lots of screen time to understand what I am able to understand today but was it worth it?

Every second was worth it, every fall was worth it every disapointment
was worth it! I am still a student of the market and a student of the
market, I'll eternally be because like I said Knowedge is Power...

Once again, this was a beautiful! Note to myself...Plan such days more often!

Mel

author: @mel
text:
I Took a short on EU today. I did not manage this trade properly.

I shorted at an unfreshed supply (a thing that I rarely do) and the
trade went +- 3 or 4 pips in profit and went against me. As soon as it
went against me I realised that price was compressed into a previous dp
(demand). The Supply I went short on was also compressed, I should have
looked beter.

Anyway, I did look at the HTF charts and saw a fresh Supply zone on the 1
 h so I decided to let the trade run. If price would have closed above
the pink line , I would have closed the trade with a loss but it wasn't
the case so I gave it a chance to run.

So ok, this trade was a winner but really the trade management was poor .
 I know there was another beautiful opportunity to go short on, but I
never add up to a loser so I did not take it.

Mel

author: @mel
text:
It's time for me to bring my journal back to life. There are some post
 missing in here but it doesen't matter, It's a new day, new site and a
new challenge.

I'll start by sharring my view on the EURUSD.

The Euro has been in a consolidation phase for some days/weeks now and
Lower TF's doesen't really show a clear direction, however to me the
Euro is bullish on HTF's.

Here is why:

Normally, I always start explaining my analysis with higher TF's but
this time I'll work my way up because there are some intresting things
to nottice when viewing it this way.

Here is a 1H chart, As you can see, the last time we saw some BIG
activity it was some Bullish activity , price broke through a Key level
and since than price was unable to close bellow the lower black line. We
 saw some "fakey" activities here and there but also some buying as
price was retesting the demand.

Now , yes the demand was tested several times so based on this TF, I
would consider that the demand would be totally consumed if price breaks
 the lower black line with a close bellow it.

Next chart is a 4H chart not a lot to add here, expect that you now can
clearly see where the Key level was. Look at the same black line and the
 blue line.

Let's look at the Daily chart now.

On the upper left, I highlighted the Supply level. Price bounced 4 times
 from there yet . So price was pushed down but yet couldn't close bellow
 lower black demand line.

The 4th chart is a weekly chart and the picture is much clearer here. explaination on chart.

Last chart is the Monthly, this one is the most clear chart. Shows a clear picture to me.

The revious months have all been bullish. Price broke a DP and closed above it (blue dashed line) and the level became demand.

A close above 1.3386 would be great (longer term) . However if we see a break and close bellow 1. 3250 I will look for shorts

Mel
